tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find companies with published short positions by name, ticker symbol or ISIN. Returns up to 5 matches (name, symbol or isin, totalShortPct, website url). Pass the returned symbol or isin to get_company_short_positions.

tools.name: get_top_short_positions
tools.description: Companies with the currently largest cumulative net short positions (home page top lists): EU = European registers, US = FINRA short interest.

tools.name: get_trending_short_positions
tools.description: Companies whose total net short position moved the most over 7 or 28 days (home page trend lists), direction = increase or decrease.

tools.name: get_recently_updated_positions
tools.description: Most recently published short position changes (feed page): positionPctChange > 0 means the position was increased, < 0 reduced.

tools.name: get_company_short_positions
tools.description: All published short positions of one company: current positions per holder, historic positions and the statistics timeseries (totalShortPct + holderCount over time). Pass symbol OR isin.

tools.name: get_shortseller_positions
tools.description: All current short positions of one short seller (shortseller page), largest position first.

tools.name: get_company_price_history
tools.description: Daily closing prices (adjusted) of one company, newest first (company page chart). Pass symbol OR isin.
